title: Apple to Launch Doorbell, Lock and Thermostat Developed With LG
description: Apple's upcoming smart home devices will include a doorbell, thermostat, and other accessories developed through a partnership with LG Electronics. Bloomberg's Nick Turner explains. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Musk’s SpaceX in Talks to Borrow $40 Billion to Buy Nvidia Chips
description: Elon Musk’s SpaceX is in talks with banks and investors to raise $40 billion of debt to buy chips from Nvidia Corp., people familiar with the matter said, underscoring the insatiable demand among AI developers for more computing power.

title: Big Take: The Unexpected Billionaires of the AI Boom
description: Forget Silicon Valley. From furniture makers to toilet manufacturers, the AI infrastructure boom is creating billionaires in the unlikeliest places. (Source: Bloomberg)
